title: Degree-zero residue cohomology of a descended line bundle
statement: Let \(f:X\to S\) be flat, proper and locally finitely presented [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume its tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is an isomorphism after every base change. Let \(L\) be invertible on \(X\) [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let \(k:W\to S\) be an immersion (a morphism factoring as a closed immersion followed by an open immersion), \(w\in W\), \(s\in S\), and \(k(w)=s\). Assume \(L_s\cong f_s^*N\) for a finite locally free module \(N\) on \(\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\) [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module, def-weil-residue-field], using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix derived-category localizations for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category], and put \(E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0])\) [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then the degree-zero derived fibre cohomology vector space at w is isomorphic, as a kappa(w)-module, to kappa(w). No assertion about negative or positive degrees is made.

source.place: Tags 0BF2, displayed derived fibre equality before the first source complex; 0BF0; 0B91(2)

proof.text: Tensor pullback and ordinary pullback are the same left adjoint to pushforward. Transport invertibility of L_W through this isomorphism, giving finite local freeness and finite presentation. On affine opens, its sections are projective and flat over the structure ring; scalar-tower transitivity with flatness of f_W gives relative flatness. Derive additivity of every tensor pullback from its left adjunction and choose standard localizations for the open sites of W.

Unpack the defining derived pullback comparison at the single complex. Form the canonical derived module base-change map at Spec kappa(w) and apply perfect_derivedDirectImage_baseChange to make it an isomorphism. The Lean proof now obtains a derived-to-ordinary comparison c, its comparison predicate, and invertibility of its direct-image composite from exists_isIso_canonicalModuleBaseChange_of_isFlatOver. The comparison is local data inside the theorem proof; the statement and the resulting cohomology object are unchanged.

Use picard_h1_base_descent_fibre_generator for a section generating everywhere on the combined fibre. Its generating locus is top, so its free-generator overIso, pulled back through the top-scheme isomorphism, trivializes the fibre module. Transport this isomorphism to the iterated fibre using pullback composition and pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso.

The degree-zero homology comparison for unbounded right-derived pushforward identifies homology with ordinary pushforward. Apply the transported fibre trivialization. The tensor structure-sheaf comparison and hO give an isomorphism on global sections of the combined fibre; fibre-product associativity transfers it to the iterated fibre. Restriction of scalars through that ring isomorphism and GammaSpecIso gives the residue-field module. Compose these module isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0B91(2), 0A1H and 0A1D; B3 retirement adaptation uses the existing perfectness-only and canonical module base-change declarations, without changing the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_directImage_fibre_cohomology_zero
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N)) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology W E 0 w ≅
      ModuleCat.of (W.residueField w) (W.residueField w))
